metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quick and long-lasting knee pain relief. 

We're going to go over three easy exercises that will help lengthen and strengthening muscles (and tendons) that support the knee. This is especially good for conditions such as knee arthritis (osteoarthritis) to general aches and stiffness.

To get the best results, make sure to go through all exercises and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give quick knee pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS. 

Watch now and get rid of knee pain at home!
